uncertainties: Cloth force simulation and transition code are not reproduced; cloth textures can be drawn statically.
Source menu positions include SD, HD and iPad overrides. This recovery retains all explicit variants and recommends SD for the480x320 view.
Props and options occupy horizontally sliding screens. Their parent placement is runtime behavior, so recommended base placement and clickable rectangles must be visually verified.
Original button titles are baked into atlas art; semantic labels here are renderer labels, not extracted text strings.

placement.note: GroupControl implementation supplies command positions; buttons.group references older missing icon-group frames.
LWSpecialsDock / LWScrollingDock calculates position; SunStar is a layered circular button.

enemyCastle.note: Template position320,160 is not proof of a global screen HUD; level may override it.

grouping.note: Source group template names icon-group.png/icon-group-attack-glow.png which are absent in the supplied atlas. Use available group directional/defense art with reconstructed placement.

mining.note: Timing fields are static source values; original runtime scheduling is not recovered.

notes: HUDS states it is a reusable template store; individual levels determine which controls appear.
Attack/defend/group docking and production slots are native runtime layout and cannot be recovered exactly from these plists alone.
Some historical templates reference absent frames, including icon-production-defend.png and icon-group.png. Do not invent a claim of exact restoration.
